proposed_widenings.name: MagicItemRecord attunement restriction metadata
proposed_widenings.justification: The current magic-item record only expresses attunement as a boolean, so it cannot encode class-gated eligibility on items that require attunement by specific classes.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Staff, Very Rare (Requires Attunement by a Druid, Sorcerer, Warlock, or Wizard)

notes: The item fits honestly as a composite magic item: passive held Fire resistance plus charge-cast spell access with dawn recharge and last-charge destruction. The encoded content omits only the druid/sorcerer/warlock/wizard attunement restriction because the surface has no record-level variant for it.
